items.title: 14.1.2 Blood Supply of the Kidney (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the blood supply of the kidney (PDF 15-16).

blocks.text: Khoon renal artery ke zariye gurde tak aata hai, jo hilum par dakhil ho kar shakhon mein batt jati hai jin se afferent arterioles banti hain. Har afferent arteriole capillaries ke aik bistar (capillary bed), glomerulus, mein jati hai. Zyada tar capillary beds venules mein khali hote hain, magar glomerulus ki capillaries efferent arteriole mein khali hoti hain.

items: Efferent arteriole peritubular capillaries mein batt jati hai, jo renal cortex mein proximal aur distal convoluted tubules ke gird ghana jaal hain.
Juxtamedullary nephrons mein efferent arterioles se vasa recta bhi banti hain, medulla mein lambi seedhi capillaries jo loops of Henle ke mutawazi (parallel) chalti hain.

Cheezon ke tabadle ke baad capillaries mil kar venules, venules bari veins aur aakhir mein renal vein banati hain, jo hilum se nikal kar inferior vena cava mein girti aur chhana hua khoon dil ko lautati hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Gurdon ko khoon bohat milta hai: dil ke kul output ka taqreeban 20 se 25% unhein jata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: cortex aur medulla mein aik nephron: chauri afferent arteriole Bowman's capsule ke andar glomerulus mein dakhil hoti aur tang efferent arteriole nikalti hai; proximal convoluted tubule medulla mein jhukne wale loop of Henle tak jati, distal convoluted tubule capsule ke paas wapas aa kar collecting duct mein girti hai; peritubular capillaries tubules ko gherti aur vasa recta loop ke saath chalti hain. Daen: renal artery se inferior vena cava tak khoon ke raaste ka flow chart.
blocks.caption: Nephron aur gurde ko khoon ki supply (topic 14.1.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Nephron mein renal corpuscle hota hai, yaani glomerulus (afferent arteriole se aane wala capillaries ka guchha) jo dohri deewar wale Bowman's capsule ke andar hai, aur renal tubule: bal khaya hua proximal convoluted tubule, U-shakal ka loop of Henle jis ki descending aur ascending limbs hain, aur bal khaya distal convoluted tubule, jo doosron ke saath collecting duct mein girta hai. Khoon renal artery se aa kar afferent arterioles, glomerulus aur efferent arteriole se guzarta, phir convoluted tubules ke gird peritubular capillaries aur juxtamedullary nephrons mein loop ke saath vasa recta se, aur aakhir mein venules aur veins renal vein ke zariye inferior vena cava tak le jati hain. Taqreeban 85% nephrons cortical hain jin ke loops chhote hain; juxtamedullary nephrons ke loops lambe aur medulla mein gehre hain.

blocks.prompt: Glomerulus se khoon le jane wali nali mein kya ghair mamooli hai, aur is ki ahmiyat kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Glomerulus venule ke bajaye arteriole (efferent arteriole) mein khali hota hai. Efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai, is liye glomerulus mein dabao zyada rehta hai, jo filtration chalata hai (topic 14.1.3).

items: Renal artery, afferent arteriole, glomerulus, efferent arteriole, peritubular capillaries (aur vasa recta), venules, renal vein, inferior vena cava.
Gurde dil ke output ka 20 se 25% lete hain.
